purpose: Prevent a validation-season availability source result from authorizing V09B fitting before the frozen 2012-2021 training availability chronology and label semantics are independently qualified.

frozen_v09b_preregistration.model_family: expected player contribution = P(active) x expected snap share x latent value

current_evidence.validation_source_basis: V09B-AVAILABILITY-REGULAR-SEASON-HARMONIZATION-V2 failed closed on its first strict execution; the failure is preserved and may not be reclassified.
current_evidence.training_source_chronology_basis: The legacy injury feed has 2012-2021 coverage, but no per-season T-120-safe chronology contract has been qualified for the training window.
current_evidence.training_label_semantics_basis: No frozen source contract has yet proven that the labels used to fit P(active) for 2012-2021 are available under the same pregame information discipline.

decision_rule: V09B execution is authorized only when every authorization requirement is satisfied simultaneously. A 2022-2025 validation-source qualification can never, by itself, authorize fitting on 2012-2021.
prohibited_rescues: do not infer active/healthy from source absence
do not use realized current-game snaps as a pregame feature
do not use retrospective inactive status to repair missing labels
do not use later injury designations
do not use completed 2026 outcomes to design, tune, or rescue the gate
